issues.title: Source attribution popup was visible in the runtime map copy
issues.detail: The exact attribution dialog and four related zhCN strings are removed only after copying the map into artifacts. The read-only source still contains the original expression and author text; the runtime-only staged copy does not.
issues.nextAction: Keep attribution cleanup scoped to staged copies; never edit the source map.

issues.title: Runtime VM calls were not durable or directly inspectable from WebUI
issues.detail: RuntimeConsole now records connect, direct API, and VM function calls as JSONL with timestamp, session, port, origin, args, result, error, status, and duration. WebUI exposes read-only /api/vibe/call-log and a persisted-log button.
issues.nextAction: Use /api/vibe/invoke for one call or /api/vibe/run-vm for a repeatable program; keep the JSONL file as the call audit trail.

issues.title: Six behavior effects needed real 斗蛐蛐 runtime evidence
issues.detail: The runtime-first Galaxy VM was exercised through the real SC2 API on the user-provided map. A fresh post-reload game returned all eight checks passed, including three death mines confirmed by RPC tags and douququ.snapshot mineCount=3. The editable user Galaxy entry also created an observed Marine and added minerals through UnitCreate and PlayerModifyPropertyInt. The final same-window ScriptError gate returned count=0.
issues.nextAction: Keep douququ.* as the live development API; defer static patch solidification to a separate later stage.

issues.title: zzerus03 Reborn map initialization is still blocked
issues.detail: The unrelated zzerus03 map-commander CreateGame attempt timed out while the Reborn native-opening wait gate remained active. This does not invalidate the verified 斗蛐蛐 runtime plugin.
issues.nextAction: Diagnose the native-opening wait gate, then rerun CreateGame/JoinGame with advancing frames and a same-window ScriptError gate.

issues.title: WebUI refused to restart an externally owned SC2 session
issues.detail: The launch paths now terminate the exact SC2/SC2Switcher process set unconditionally before starting the requested launcher.
issues.nextAction: Keep the exact process-name allowlist and verify the process table is empty before removing runtime leases.

issues.title: WebUI could auto-select an expired Bank session
issues.detail: The WebUI stopped selecting sessions[0] by sequence. RuntimeConsole now probes candidates with side-effect-free douququ.runtime.status, skips SESSION_EXPIRED, and reports the accepted session in session_recovery.
issues.nextAction: Keep session probing as the connection contract; do not reintroduce sequence-based latest-session selection.

issues.title: Map-detail pane could report an unscanned state after a successful source response
issues.detail: Map details and editable shell resources now bypass caches, superseded fetches are aborted, and read/render failures expose their actual error instead of the misleading unscanned label. A real browser click on 天界封锁 completed without an error.
issues.nextAction: Keep map-detail API and editable WebUI resources non-cacheable while this local development server serves live source analysis.

issues.title: Revolution Overdrive map details rejected the UI display name
issues.detail: The map-detail API now resolves both [起义狂潮] 欢迎来到丛林 and ttosh02.SC2Map to the same source map. The frontend also reports non-JSON responses with their HTTP metadata and a bounded response snippet.
issues.nextAction: Keep display-name normalization for map-detail requests when supporting older saved presets or frontend clients.
